market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: It is extremely early for the 2028 election, and Rubio is just one of many potential Republican candidates. Even a generous estimate of his nomination odds (~10%) combined with a ~50% general election win conditional on nomination gives about 5% overall. The market's 14.2% seems too high for a candidate who hasn't solidified a frontrunner position and faces an uncertain path.
evidence_points: 2028 GOP primary field is expected to be large, diluting any single candidate's chance.
Historical data shows early long-shot presidential candidates are often overpriced in prediction markets.
Rubio's previous failed 2016 bid and decline in national prominence reduce his probability.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of political prediction markets (e.g., Polymarket, Metaculus)
